Text.Text: The school is finished. Use the precision you earned without enjoying the harm it can do. You've finished my Viral Cascade trials. I have no further work for you here.
These trials require rank 50 in Vibroknife. Reach it, then return. Knowing where to cut starts with knowing your knife.

A crew in the militia annex is teaching reckless knife work. Recover their drill ledger so I can see what their instructors are rewarding. Defeat six Vital Rupture Adepts in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Veles Drill Ledger; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims. I'll give you the Veles Militia Annex Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Viral Cascade.

Here's the Veles Militia Annex Key. Use 'Veles Militia Annex' in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Vital Rupture Adepts, then return with the Vital Rupture Veles Drill Ledger.

Vital Rupture is the name of the school you're confronting. The technique these trials qualify you to learn is Viral Cascade. Recovering its records and defeating its master will show me you're ready for that training.

Use 'Veles Militia Annex' in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Vital Rupture Adepts in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Veles Drill Ledger; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims.
The adepts in there are quick studies with dull technique. Six of them, practicing on each other and on anyone who wanders in. Don't get flattered by an easy first cut - the second one won't be.
Defeat six Vital Rupture Adepts in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Veles Drill Ledger; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims.
You've defeated six Vital Rupture Adepts. Let me see the Vital Rupture Veles Drill Ledger.
Now we can account for what happened under their care. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are using the range relay for their drills. Bring it back and interrupt the program. Defeat five Vital Rupture Specialists in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Militia Range Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims.
Your key still grants access to Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Defeat five Vital Rupture Specialists to secure the Vital Rupture Militia Range Relay, then return to me.

A rupture cut opens the femoral or the brachial and lets pressure do the rest. Done right, it's over before they understand what happened. Done sloppy, and this annex is full of sloppy, you get someone who bleeds for ten minutes screaming instead of ten seconds quiet. That's cruelty pretending to be skill.

Use 'Veles Militia Annex' in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat five Vital Rupture Specialists in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Militia Range Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims.
Five specialists who've had the adepts' mistakes beaten out of them. They'll test your guard before your grip. Don't rush the count - dead is dead whether you took your time or not.
Defeat five Vital Rupture Specialists in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Militia Range Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims.
You've defeated five Vital Rupture Specialists. Let me see the Vital Rupture Militia Range Relay.
The equipment is back where it belongs. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects the knife school. Recover his challenge badge and end that watch. Defeat the Vital Rupture Warden in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Scored Challenge Badge; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Veles Militia Annex, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Vital Rupture Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Vital Rupture Scored Challenge Badge.

Every one of these students learned the cut from someone who learned it from someone who never treated a wound in his life. It shows in how they hold the blade, like it's a threat and not a tool. The warden trained half of them personally. That should tell you what his lesson looks like.
In Viscara, Veles Militia Annex, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Vital Rupture Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker.
He has opened quicker hands than yours, and he did it alone against people who came alone. Don't. Bring the two you trust, or don't bring yourself.

Defeat the Vital Rupture Warden in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Scored Challenge Badge; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Vital Rupture Warden. Let me see the Vital Rupture Scored Challenge Badge.
The warden can no longer protect that school. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four instructors still authorize those drills. Take their challenge chit. Defeat four members of the Vital Rupture Inner Circle in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Captain's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims.
Your key still grants access to Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Defeat four members of the Vital Rupture Inner Circle to secure the Vital Rupture Captain's Challenge Chit, then return to me.

The ledger told me who was still sloppy. The relay told me who was logging kills to pad a report. The badge told me the warden finally lost to someone who deserved it. Bring me their chit and I'll tell you what it says about the four of them.

Use 'Veles Militia Annex' in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat four members of the Vital Rupture Inner Circle in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Captain's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims.
Four of them, and they fight like people who've never had to fight alone. Neither should you. Bring backup, or count on being outnumbered the whole way through.

Defeat four members of the Vital Rupture Inner Circle in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Vital Rupture Captain's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims.
You've defeated four members of the Vital Rupture Inner Circle. Let me see the Vital Rupture Captain's Challenge Chit.
Their senior staff have lost the authority to continue. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last instructor keeping the school alive. Defeat him in the Militia Command Room and report back. Defeat the Vital Rupture Master in Viscara, Militia Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Militia Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Vital Rupture Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

One rule, and it's the only one that's mattered from the first cut to this one: don't enjoy it. The moment the bleed stops being technique and starts being pleasure, you've become one of his students instead of mine.
In Viscara, Militia Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Vital Rupture Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.
He taught the rupture cut before the warden ever held a knife. No one who went in solo came out to correct that record. Bring the people you'd bleed for, because down there, you might.

Defeat the Vital Rupture Master in Viscara, Militia Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Racin' Jims; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Vital Rupture Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The school is finished. Use the precision you earned without enjoying the harm it can do. You've earned the right to train Viral Cascade. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the ledger.
I'll defeat six Vital Rupture Adepts.
How does this school relate to Viral Cascade?
Where do I find the annex?
What should I expect from the adepts?
Not yet.
Here's the Vital Rupture Veles Drill Ledger.
Back to the relay.
I'll defeat five Vital Rupture Specialists.
What exactly is a rupture cut?
Where are the specialists training?
What should I expect this time?
I need more time.
Here's the Vital Rupture Militia Range Relay.
Back to the badge.
I'll defeat the Vital Rupture Warden.
What's wrong with how these students fight?
Where's the warden's floor?
What should I know about him?
Not with strangers at my back.
Here's the Vital Rupture Scored Challenge Badge.
Back to the chit.
I'll defeat four members of the Vital Rupture Inner Circle.
What do these proofs tell you?
Where's the inner circle hiding?
What am I walking into?
Give me a day to find my two.
Here's the Vital Rupture Captain's Challenge Chit.
Back to it.
I'll face the Vital Rupture Master and report back.
Is there a rule I should know?
Where do I find him?
What should I expect from the master?
I need to be sure of my company first.
The Vital Rupture Master is defeated. Here's my report.
